_about: The figures the panel reports do not contain. build.py reads every score and measured cost from ../ArchiveProcessor/segbench-results/; only what is below is entered by hand. Each entry says where it came from.

sonnet_api_estimate.source: The panel ran Sonnet through the subscription (claude -p), so it has no measured price. Estimate: (image tokens + prompt tokens) x $2/M input + output tokens x $10/M output, at the Claude API list price for claude-sonnet-5-5 (claude-api skill, cached 2026-10-06). Image tokens = w x h / 750 over the 99 panel images (long side 999-2400 px): mean 1,522 if the API downsizes to 1568 px / 1.15 MP, 4,505 at 2576 px / 3.75 MP. Prompt about 150 tokens (the Gemini and Qwen routes report 1,337-1,404 input tokens including the image). Output 816 tokens a page, the claude -p mean in ocr-panel-cloud.md, which may include some harness overhead. Not measured: token counting needs an API key this Mac does not have.

batch.source: OpenRouter's model catalogue (https://openrouter.ai/api/v1/models, read 2026-10-15) lists a ':batch' variant of these models at half the standard price per input and output token. Gemini 3.8 Flash's catalogue price has risen to $0.825/$4.125 since the run, which paid $0.75/$3.75; its batch price $0.375/$1.875 is half the run's price. Mistral OCR's 50% batch discount is Mistral's own (https://mistral.ai/pricing/api/); third-party pages confirm $2 per 1,000 pages for OCR 4, not yet for 4.1. Routes not listed had no batch variant in the catalogue (DeepInfra's own batch API is 20% off, but the panel did not use it).

own_hardware.source: Routes run on our own hardware, not a paid endpoint. The Mac routes cost no money; the FarmShare route is too large for the Mac, so it is priced at OpenRouter's rate for the same model (openrouter_open_weights). Scores, speed and memory are read from segbench-results; only names and machines are entered here. Mac: ocr-mac-local.md (W41.mac-local-measure), mlx-community/Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct-4bit through mlx-vlm; ocr-mac-local-hw.md (W41.mac-local-hw), the Vision OCR lab's handwriting pick LightOnOCR-3-4B (prithivMLmods/LightOnOCR-3-4B-MLX, 8bit, at its card's settings) and runner-up Qwen3.5-9B (mlx-community/Qwen3.5-9B-4bit, the panel's prompt, thinking off), on the same Mac. FarmShare: farmshare/truth/ (cbd0e68c), Qwen/Qwen3.6-27B-FP8 on vLLM 0.31.0, one L40S per run (scripts/segbench/institutional-compute/README.md); its GPU time on Stanford's cluster is shown beside that price. Added 2026-10-21 (completeness rule, README): every other FarmShare run of the 96 truth pages in farmshare/truth/, with the settings in its summary.json. One priced at OpenRouter's rate is a model OpenRouter sells (openrouter_open_weights, or a route's own 'price', read from https://openrouter.ai/api/v1/models on the date given: Qwen3-VL 8B is sold as qwen/qwen3-vl-8b-instruct at $0.25/$0.75, though it fits on the Mac). A run of a model OpenRouter does not sell (GLM-OCR, LightOnOCR-3, PaddleOCR-VL 1.5, PP-OCRv6, CHURRO-3B, Qwen3.5 4B; checked 2026-10-21) has no hosted price and is drawn in the free column with its own marker, as free on a university cluster, with its GPU-hours beside it.

qwen3.5-9b-sherlock.name: Qwen3.5 9B (Sherlock)
qwen3.5-9b-sherlock.machine: one GPU, Stanford Sherlock (W46.ocr-logprob's run, log-probabilities on)

openrouter_open_weights.source: Models too large for the 18 GB M3 Pro are priced as if the same requests went to OpenRouter, not as free. Rates are OpenRouter's catalogue list prices per million input and output tokens for the same open-weight model (https://openrouter.ai/api/v1/models, read 2026-10-20); every model below is listed there, so none needed an estimate from a similar model. A FarmShare run's price is its own measured tokens (summary.json or pages.csv mean prompt and completion tokens) at these rates. A model not listed here fits on the Mac (CHURRO-3B, GLM-OCR, Qari 4B, Fanar 7B, the 2B and 4B fine-tunes, Qwen3-VL 8B, Qwen3.5 4B) and stays free, though it was run on FarmShare. The key is the run's FS_PRESET with any '-dyn' suffix removed. Ling 3 Flash VL was read on 2026-10-21: OpenRouter lists inclusionai/ling-3.0-flash-vl (Hugging Face inclusionAI/Ling-3.0-flash-VL) at $0.06 in and $0.18 out, served by one provider, DeepInfra, at fp16; the FarmShare run used the publisher's fp8 checkpoint of the same model on four L40S, too large for the Mac.

dating_tokens.source: date-tagging.json keeps no token counts for the FarmShare dating runs, so the means are entered here: promptTokenCount and candidatesTokenCount averaged over the 300 cached answers in ~/Library/Caches/ArchiveSuiteRehearsal/date-tagging/answers-<model>/ (read 2026-10-20). Runs with thinking on stop at the 512-token cap.
